new_today_news.headline: Restaurant employment slipped by 7,200 jobs in October
new_today_news.summary: Foodservice and drinking places lost 7,200 jobs in October on a seasonally-adjusted basis, following a period of relatively steady employment earlier in 2026. Restaurant hiring has been uneven throughout the year with declines at summer start, a jump in August, and decline again in October.

new_today_news.headline: Don't let holiday cooking clog your pipes: the 2026 holiday grease roundup Is here!
new_today_news.summary: North Texas announces free FOG recycling collection program running November 1, 2026–January 31, 2027. The 2025 initiative collected 8,591 gallons of used cooking oil and grease, converting it into clean fuel feedstock.

recent_news.headline: Industrial Grease Recovery Systems: Greasezilla Expands Operations
recent_news.summary: Greasezilla is expanding industrial grease recovery systems through installation at Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission's Newark Bay facility. The system processes grease-trap waste into reusable materials for renewable fuel feedstock, helping wastewater operators manage waste streams while supporting resource recovery efforts.

recent_news.headline: UCO Fraud Alert: Malaysia Tightens Controls on Used Cooking Oil Exports
recent_news.summary: Malaysian government tightening controls on UCO exports amid concerns that virgin palm oil may be mislabeled as waste-based feedstock. Industry warns of serious fraud risks involving UCO, with potential environmental impact on deforestation and biodiversity.

recent_news.headline: 5 best new restaurant openings and dining updates in Boston (November 5, 2026)
recent_news.summary: Multiple new restaurants are opening in Boston in fall 2026, including Cini Coffee, Fumo, Uchi (high-end sushi), and Roma Pizza & Company, signaling continued market activity and expansion in the Northeast dining sector.

recent_news.headline: Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission Selects Greasezilla to Process Up to 15 Million Gallons of FOG Annually
recent_news.summary: Greasezilla announced deployment of its FOG separation and recovery system at Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission's Newark facility, capable of processing up to 15 million gallons of hauled grease-trap waste annually. The modular technology separates raw grease-trap waste into water, pasteurized solids, and clean Brown Grease without chemical polymers for renewable fuel production.

recent_news.headline: Where to eat next: 18 new restaurants opening in November
recent_news.summary: Philadelphia and suburbs are seeing 18 new restaurant openings in November 2026, ranging from caviar-focused establishments near Rittenhouse Square to Japanese omakase in Cherry Hill, indicating strong new unit development activity.

recent_news.headline: Clean Harbors Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Results
recent_news.summary: Clean Harbors announced Q3 2026 record revenue of $1.87 billion (up 21% year-over-year) and net income of $208.1 million (up 75%). Adjusted EBITDA increased 42% to $456.1 million with a record margin of 24.4%. The company raised full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance and credited strong environmental services demand.

backfill_news.headline: Top 8 Softwares for Grease Trap Cleaning Businesses in 2026
backfill_news.summary: Comparative software guide identifying QuoteIQ as best for most grease trap operators covering recurring job scheduling, quoting, and route optimization starting at $29.99/month, with ServiceCore and PumpDocket as FOG-specific alternatives.
